title: Jet Ski Rental
includes: Temporary Boaters Safety Certificate (Allows you to drive)
Up to 2 people per jet ski per reservation!
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embarking on a jet ski adventure with Virginia Beach Watersports and have an exhilarating experience on the water. Our top-of-the-line jet skis are designed for both thrill-seekers and those new to the sport, ensuring a safe and enjoyable ride. Before setting out, our friendly and knowledgeable staff provide a comprehensive safety briefing, equipping you with the confidence needed to navigate the waves. Whether you're seeking high-speed excitement or a leisure ride, our jet ski rentals provide an unforgettable way to experience the beauty of Virginia Beach from the water.
